meta.source: C7S3 fortnite.gg scrape 2026-08-07; C7S4 launch roster maintainer-curated 2026-08-20 (recallDustCost 0 pending fortnite.gg)
meta.notes: C7S4 catalog v36 / image v6 (2026-09-16): Morgana, Crash Bandicoot, Blinky, Pond, and Birthday Sprites seeded Base-only with releaseDate 2026-09-17T13:00:00Z. Rarity omitted (TBD) for those five. BountyHunter variant added for the full catalog roster (C7S3 + C7S4 + the new Bases) — confirmed Reaper-material replacement; Gummy/Holofoil return scrapped (#360/#10 closed). BountyHunter closed:false until the treatment is final. Artwork-only — events.json and lobby-hacks.json untouched. Trick-or-Treat skipped. C7S4 roster: 12 launch Sprites with Base/Gold/CheatMaster (Klombo, Sonic, Tails, Shadow, Jackrabbit, 8-Bit, Crown, Adventure, Jonesy, Killswitch, Storm Scout, and Bush also LootHacker) plus Onigiri (Base/Gold/CheatMaster/LootHacker), X-Ray (Base/Gold/CheatMaster/LootHacker), Overshield (Base/Gold/CheatMaster/LootHacker), and Mega Man (Base); recallDustCost 0 and dropChancePercent omitted until fortnite.gg. C7S4 omitted from completeSprites/completeSeasons and sprites[].closed until the variant roster is final. CheatMaster and LootHacker are not closed Variants. Additive sprites[].closed / variants[].closed gate Collector/Master (explicit flag wins over completeSprites/completeVariants). C7S3 recallDustCost and dropChancePercent from fortnite.gg; dropChancePercent is Sprite Chest % as listed (0 may mean currently unavailable). punk:Gem removed (never listed on fortnite.gg). seasons[] drives active-season checklist default (half-open [start,end); C7S3/C7S4 boundary 2026-08-20T08:00:00Z; C7S4 end not confirmed). schemaVersion 2 adds achievements{} — Achievement availability is catalog-driven; a completeness list gates both the collected and mastered axes of its scope, disableAchievement wins over all, globals (allCollected/allTime) stay off until their rosters are final. schemaVersion 3 adds seasons[].spriteOrder for In-game checklist sort.
